# Be The Man

> Be The Man (The Be The Man System) is a seven-step consistency system for Christian men, created by Brian Greene, a pastor and certified marriage counselor. It helps men do what they said, every week: one sentence on who they are becoming, goals with dates, commitments tied to a time and place, and a weekly scorecard. Step 1 is free. Tagline: "Faith should function."

Be The Man is not run by a church or a denomination. The weekly emails teach the mechanism (when, where, what trigger, and how you would know it worked); faith is at the center and scripture is the standard.

## Start here
- [Step 1, free worksheet](https://bethemansystem.com/step-1/): "What type of man do you want to be?" Five qualities, what each looks like in real life, and one sentence that names him. 20 minutes, a pen, no card.
- [Home](https://bethemansystem.com/): the seven steps, why a system works (in one study 91% of people who wrote down when and where they would act followed through, against 38% who didn't), and FAQs.

## The seven steps
1. What type of man do you want to be?
2. What are your goals?
3. What has stopped you so far?
4. The laws of a system that holds
5. The four pillars
6. Why you need a system
7. God at the center

All eleven for $97; Father Kit $29; Faith Kit $29.
- [Couples counseling](https://bethemansystem.com/couples/): certified marriage counseling for engaged and married couples with Brian Greene. Each partner takes a validated relationship assessment online, then three sessions together. $300 for three sessions; the $35 assessment fee is paid to the assessment provider.
- The Inner Circle: a small group, by application.

## About
- [Brian Greene](https://bethemansystem.com/about/): husband of eleven years, father of three, pastor of ten years, certified marriage counselor. Grew up without a father in the house. Holds himself to six written laws: Clock, Source, Failure, Proximity, Evidence and Protection.
